- Subprocessors: attached is an initial subprocessor list (subprocessor_list_20280514.csv). Most entries are limited to build pipeline/container registry/CDN — no training or telemetry pipelines consume customer data.
- Data transfers: for on-prem deployments we keep egress limited to support telemetry (optional) and only after opt-in; telemetry is aggregated and sampled, and we can turn it off for regulated accounts.

Maya — thanks for the questions. Short answers and proposed contract language below. I will flag the items that require legal input.

1) Model training: Redwood does not train models on customer request data for hosted or private deployments unless explicitly agreed and in writing. Proposed clause: "Provider will not use Customer Data to train or improve Provider models without Customer's prior written consent." (legal: OK to include?)

2) Key escrow: we support two operational modes:
  - No-escrow BYOK: customer sole possession of key material; Redwood receives wrapped keys or uses an HSM-proxy where operations occur inside the customer's control plane.
  - Escrow with controls: if customer requires escrow for DR, we can offer an encrypted escrow with the following controls: dual operator access, escrow access only upon mutually agreed conditions, and hardware-backed escrow keystore (HSM). Escrow must be explicitly requested in SOW.

3) Telemetry/subprocessors: our telemetry pipeline can be disabled. Default telemetry aggregates anonymized metrics only (cpu, error rates, tail latencies). We will confirm that stack traces and request payloads are never sent to external telemetry unless a customer explicitly enables debug logs and approves sharing. Proposed clause: "Provider will not transmit Customer Data to third-party telemetry processors without Customer's explicit opt-in."

4) Cross-border: for VPC/on-prem customers with an EU residency requirement we will:
  - Deploy the control and data plane within EU regions only;
  - Disable optional telemetry egress;
  - Provide a list of storage/backup endpoints and apply Region-only routing policies.

Attachments: BYOK_operational_note.txt contains an overview of HSM connector modes and the breakglass flow.

Legal items: please confirm if the escrow model is acceptable and whether Everwell requires a specific certified HSM vendor (e.g., Thales/Entrust). Also please send SOC 2 contact info; we will share the report under NDA.

Best,
